answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, slashed on a failed audit, rewards vest against future work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the garden of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The summit lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the copper is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
